title: Three-Project Solution Scaffold + IKeychainProvider
description: Create the complete solution structure with three projects, correct project references, build properties, and a fully implemented IKeychainProvider abstraction with all four concrete platform implementations. This is the security foundation — all credential storage is built on top of this.
prerequisiteState: Empty repository. Only tech_spec/ and .ai/ folders exist. No src/ directory yet.
goal: Produce a compilable three-project .NET 10 solution where IKeychainProvider is fully defined and all four implementations (macOS, Windows, Linux, encrypted-file fallback) are correctly wired with runtime platform detection. The keychain key format for this project is 'zapi-cli:<accountName>:oauth'.
scope: Create src/zapi-cli.sln referencing all four projects using 'dotnet new sln --format sln' (legacy .sln, not .slnx)
Create src/ZapiCli/ZapiCli.csproj (net10.0, TreatWarningsAsErrors=true, Nullable=enable, ImplicitUsings=enable, AssemblyName=zapi-cli, OutputType=Exe)
Create src/ZapiCli.Core/ZapiCli.Core.csproj (net10.0, TreatWarningsAsErrors=true, Nullable=enable, ImplicitUsings=enable; NO Spectre.Console reference)
Create src/ZapiCli.Keychain/ZapiCli.Keychain.csproj (net10.0, TreatWarningsAsErrors=true, Nullable=enable, ImplicitUsings=enable; NO dependency on Core or ZapiCli)
Create tests/ZapiCli.Tests/ZapiCli.Tests.csproj (net10.0, xUnit, Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk, xunit.runner.visualstudio; references ZapiCli.Core and ZapiCli.Keychain)
Set project references: ZapiCli → ZapiCli.Core + ZapiCli.Keychain; ZapiCli.Core → ZapiCli.Keychain

Create src/ZapiCli.Keychain/IKeychainProvider.cs: interface with GetAsync(string key, CancellationToken ct = default) → Task<string?>, SetAsync(string key, string value, CancellationToken ct = default) → Task, DeleteAsync(string key, CancellationToken ct = default) → Task

Create src/ZapiCli.Keychain/MacOsKeychainProvider.cs: P/Invoke to Security.framework (SecKeychainAddGenericPassword, SecKeychainFindGenericPassword, SecKeychainItemDelete). Service name: 'zapi-cli'. [SupportedOSPlatform("macos")] attribute on class.

Create src/ZapiCli.Keychain/WindowsKeychainProvider.cs: P/Invoke to advapi32.dll CredWrite/CredRead/CredDelete. Credential type: CRED_TYPE_GENERIC (1). [SupportedOSPlatform("windows")] attribute on class.

Create src/ZapiCli.Keychain/LinuxKeychainProvider.cs: P/Invoke to libsecret-1.so.0 via TryCreate() factory — catches DllNotFoundException + probe failure to signal fallback needed. Attributes: { 'application': 'zapi-cli', 'key': '<keystring>' }.

Create src/ZapiCli.Keychain/EncryptedFileKeychainProvider.cs: AES-256-GCM using machine entropy derived key. Key derivation: SHA256(MachineName + MachineGuid + 'zapi-cli'). MachineGuid: ioreg on macOS, registry HKLMv SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Cryptography\MachineGuid on Windows, /etc/machine-id on Linux. File layout: [12-byte IV][ciphertext][16-byte GCM tag]. File path: <configDir>/keystore/<sanitized-key>.bin (replace ':' with '_').

Create src/ZapiCli.Keychain/KeychainProviderFactory.cs: static Create(string configDir) method — uses OperatingSystem.IsMacOS(), OperatingSystem.IsWindows(), OperatingSystem.IsLinux() (NOT RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform — Roslyn CA1416 analyzer only recognises OperatingSystem.IsXxx()). Linux: try LinuxKeychainProvider.TryCreate(); fall back to EncryptedFileKeychainProvider on failure.
Create src/ZapiCli/Program.cs stub: empty CommandApp with Spectre.Console reference. No commands yet. Ensure it compiles.
Create src/ZapiCli/DependencyInjectionRegistrar.cs: bridge between Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection and Spectre.Console.Cli's ITypeRegistrar interface.
Create tests/ZapiCli.Tests/Fakes/InMemoryKeychainProvider.cs: thread-safe dictionary-based IKeychainProvider for all future test stories.
Create tests/ZapiCli.Tests/PlaceholderTests.cs: single passing xUnit test — ensures dotnet test compiles and runs.
Run 'dotnet build src/zapi-cli.sln' and confirm 0 errors, 0 warnings.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build src/zapi-cli.sln succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
IKeychainProvider interface is in ZapiCli.Keychain namespace with exactly GetAsync, SetAsync, DeleteAsync signatures
All four IKeychainProvider implementations exist as separate classes in src/ZapiCli.Keychain/
All platform-specific methods carry [SupportedOSPlatform] attributes to satisfy CA1416 with TreatWarningsAsErrors=true
EncryptedFileKeychainProvider uses AES-256-GCM (not CBC or ECB). IV stored as first 12 bytes.
No third-party NuGet keychain package referenced in any .csproj
ZapiCli.Core.csproj has zero reference to Spectre.Console
ZapiCli.Keychain.csproj has zero reference to ZapiCli.Core or ZapiCli
TreatWarningsAsErrors=true and Nullable=enable present in all four .csproj files
InMemoryKeychainProvider exists in tests/ and implements IKeychainProvider fully
contextForAgent: This is the foundation story. Nothing else can be built until this passes. Read ADR-0007 for the three-project layout and dependency graph. Read ADR-0005 for the full keychain design including P/Invoke signatures for each platform. Read ADR-0001 for .csproj build requirements. The keychain key format is 'zapi-cli:<accountName>:oauth' (e.g. 'zapi-cli:work:oauth'). The CRITICAL pitfall: use OperatingSystem.IsMacOS() not RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform() — the Roslyn CA1416 analyzer only recognises OperatingSystem.IsXxx() as valid platform guards. Use 'dotnet new sln --format sln' to create the .sln file (not .slnx which is the new default in .NET 10). Config dir resolution: Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.ApplicationData) on macOS/Linux + append 'zapi-cli'; Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData) on Windows + append 'zapi-cli'. For machine entropy in EncryptedFileKeychainProvider: 'zapi-cli' is the salt (not 'cliq-cli').

openItems.item: Machine entropy key derivation for EncryptedFileKeychainProvider
openItems.defaultAssumption: See OQ-005. Use SHA256(MachineName + MachineGuid + 'zapi-cli') as AES-256 key. IV stored as first 12 bytes of .bin file, then ciphertext, then 16-byte GCM tag.

See OQ-006. Catch DllNotFoundException when loading libsecret-1.so.0. Perform a sentinel probe on init. If any failure, return false from TryCreate() to activate EncryptedFileKeychainProvider fallback.

openItems.item: macOS keychain ACL on unsigned builds
openItems.defaultAssumption: Use kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlocked. If keychain returns errSecAuthFailed on a developer build, log and activate fallback.
